input.free_text_description: This system is a messaging platform that serves Admin, Candidate roles. The platform provides capabilities for i batch queryable, i channel sms, i message. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Admin, I want to search and filter records, so that I can quickly find relevant information.
As a Admin, I want to receive notifications about important events, so that I can stay informed and respond promptly.
As a Admin, I want to interact with base functionality, so that I can accomplish my base-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to use i channel sms capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Admin, I want to use ali sms capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
